comparisons.name: revealed-light
comparisons.description: The revealed bars of the full-screen Photos window where the bar is empty, Aqua: the title bar 22 pt down, its edge and the shadow it casts on the content. The menu bar above it is the screen's and shows the desktop picture through its material, so its 22 pt are masked.

comparisons.name: revealed-dark
comparisons.description: The revealed bars of the full-screen Photos window where the bar is empty, Dark Aqua. The menu bar's 22 pt are masked, as in revealed-light. The capture's bar is tinted by the desktop picture.

comparisons.name: top-light
comparisons.description: The menu bar hidden: the bar of the active Split View tile at the very top of the screen, where it is empty, and 12 pt of the page under it, Aqua. No toolbar item or text is in the crop.

comparisons.name: top-dark
comparisons.description: The menu bar hidden: the bar of the active Split View tile at the very top of the screen, Dark Aqua. The capture's bar is tinted by the page under it, which the mean colour difference shows.

comparisons.name: hidden-light
comparisons.description: A window whose title bar hides with the menu bar, pointer away: the content reaches the top of the screen, Aqua. No screenshot shows it.
